candidates.title: Custom Photo Multi Upload Assistant Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive multi-photo validation sub-flow on the upload screen that guides users to select compatible photos before generation.
candidates.why: Support emails mention failures and visual errors during custom pet creation; assisting user upload quality reduces drop-off during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Select up to 3 clear front-facing photos for best custom pet generation.

components.text: Good lighting and clear background improve accuracy.

guard.reason: Valid interactive sub-flow added within photo upload onboarding step.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and support tickets confirm photo upload issues; new_flow changes have positive historical precedence.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Split Progress Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split view with live status steps, estimated time, and tip indicators.
candidates.why: The home stage takes a long median time (201s, mean 2336s). Redesigning the waiting view keeps users engaged during load.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are building your custom companion models and preparing desktop animations.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the waiting screen maintaining its core job.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is already relatively high, and redesigns consistently degrade performance.

candidates.title: Pet Name Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet naming step between friend selection and adoption certificate to personalize the pet companion before finalizing setup.
candidates.why: Adoption stage conversion drops to 63.3%. A dedicated naming screen increases emotional attachment before final certificate generation.

new_pet_name.headline: Give Your Pet a Name
new_pet_name.body: Choose a name to register your companion on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid new personalization screen added within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses many users, but adding new screens typically shows no positive effect or slight friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Quick Interactive Tutorial Flow
candidates.change: Adds interactive quick-action demonstration cards to the home intro screen detailing hotkeys and visibility controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Learn how to interact with and control your pet directly from your desktop toolbar.

guard.reason: Valid interactive tutorial addition to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop is high and supported by user tickets; new_flow implementations show moderate positive potential.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Verification Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit notification hint on the sign-in screen informing users that authenticating preserves pet save data across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Clear messaging upfront improves account linking confidence.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion state and syncs pet inventory to your account.

guard.reason: Valid informative hint added to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 8 user emails and low cost config; sign_in hint showed +1.0% in past test.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Category Grid Layout
candidates.change: Updates the pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid with step counter enabled.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 63.3% conversion rate and median duration of 89s. Grid layout streamlines visual companion choices.

guard.reason: Valid layout update to the pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets high-drop adoption stage; layout change yielded slight positive noise-corrected lift (+0.5%).

candidates.title: Companion Path Time Estimate Hint
candidates.change: Adds time duration estimates to path selection options on choose_path screen.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s compared to median 8s, indicating hesitation for some users. Clear time estimates set expectations.

choose_path.hint: Presets take under 1 minute; custom creation takes ~2 minutes.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Displays clear stage progress status updates while loading pet assets on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High average waiting time (mean 2336s) causes user uncertainty. Granular stage updates reassure users the app has not stalled.

guard.reason: Valid status progress tracker added to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info tested negative (-0.1% across 2 tests) with low overall step drop.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout highlighting key companion features and immediate launch action.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%. A clean spotlight focal layout helps finalize setup smoothly.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage has large drop, but finish redesigns consistently hurt performance (-2.1% across 2 tests).

candidates.change: Adds a decorative badge component celebrating adoption confirmation on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Enhancing adoption milestone rewards increases completion rates through the adoption step.

guard.reason: The adoption certificate component replacement removes the required official stamp.
